scope: Bounded local model two-pass single-card review; not independent human approval.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I kept twelve tickets from our trips. How many did you keep?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't keep tickets.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then how will we compare devotion?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember the trips.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I remember them and maintained an archive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I kept twelve tickets from our trips. How many did you keep?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: None. I made you that album instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I kept it. Your care is safe because of mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. I put all my tickets inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm preserving both our collections. Let me get it a waterproof cover.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 explicitly compares devotion; A5 counts remembering plus archiving as superior care.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's lack of tickets prompts A3's comparison problem; B4's memories become A5's additional category.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 defend a credible different way of remembering, but reveal little personal investment.

heightening.evidence: A5 adds memory to the archive claim without substantially increasing its consequence.

specificity.evidence: A1's twelve trip tickets establish a playable shared history and concrete evidence.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'maintained an archive' earns its dry competitiveness from A1's ticket collection.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 makes preserving B's affectionate album evidence of superior care; A5 claims responsibility for both collections.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's album becomes A3's preservation claim; B4's hidden tickets make A5's 'both our collections' possible.

relationship.evidence: B2 defends a different expression of affection, and B4 corrects A's assumption without starting an argument.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands from keeping the album to safeguarding both collections with a waterproof cover.

specificity.evidence: A1's twelve trip tickets and B2's album establish a shared history through immediately playable objects.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Your care is safe because of mine' efficiently expresses the competitive logic that generates A5's cover.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 introduces the album as evidence of care; A3 appropriates its preservation as stronger evidence.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 reveals B's tickets inside the album, allowing A5 to claim stewardship of both collections.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1 compares keepsakes, A3 subordinates B's gesture to A's care, and A5 adds protective effort.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 turns a correction into a larger claim of caring responsibility and a new practical favor.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A turns shared memories and their preservation into comparative evidence of caring more.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Sentimental collecting could explain keeping tickets without explaining a contest over devotion.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A3 asks how to 'compare devotion'; A5 claims memory and preservation together.

records.recommendedEdit: The original's 84 falls below acceptance. The revision preserves the trip setting and gives B an affectionate counterclaim. Internal reread: fidelity 5 (A3 claims superior care), logic 5 (B2 supplies the album; B4 supplies its tickets), relationship 4 (B defends a real gift), heightening 4 (A5 assumes protection of both collections), specificity 5 (A1 and B2 establish tangible keepsakes), brevityWit 4 (A5's waterproof cover follows the preservation claim): 92. B4 makes A5's expanded custody possible.
records.remainingConcern: A5's superiority claim is slightly implicit, but 'both our collections' sustains it. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A3's credit for keeping a gift needs sincere gratitude beneath the competitive accounting.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative a competes over shared memories and preservation; b bargains over the distribution of immediate physical effort.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry the heavier bag. I care more about your back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it for a while.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'd appear to care more about mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if I take the side with the books.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry the heavier bag. I care more about your back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it for a while.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'd appear to care more about mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if I take the side with the books.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims greater care through carrying; A3 treats B's reciprocation as a competing claim.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's offer becomes A3's threatened reversal; B4's sharing proposal determines A5's unequal division.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to relieve A and B4 offers cooperation, forcing A to adapt.

heightening.evidence: A5 accepts sharing while reserving the book-heavy side as greater sacrifice.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes carrying a heavy bag; A5 supplies its unevenly weighted books.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's brief condition converts B4's practical solution directly into the same competition.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims greater concern for B's back; A3 treats reciprocation as a threat to that superiority; A5 reserves more weight.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 offers to carry the bag, prompting A3's reversal concern; B4 proposes sharing, prompting A5's unequal split.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers reciprocal care and B4 seeks cooperation, each requiring A to adjust the competitive tactic.

heightening.evidence: A5 accepts cooperation only by finding an advantage within it: carrying the book-heavy side.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes carrying heavy bags and concern for B's back; A5 supplies books as the concrete source of weight.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's short condition earns its joke from B4's sharing proposal, though A3 states the competition quite explicitly.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2's offer would shift the caring sacrifice to B; A3 explicitly reacts to that reversal.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 introduces sharing, and A5 specifies a way to share while still sacrificing more.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: The card explains why A resists relief and demands the heavier portion of a cooperative solution.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 moves from competing over who carries the bag to competing within the proposed shared carry.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A converts carrying and sharing a burden into proof of providing more care than B.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Generosity alone would welcome B's help without defending a superior share of sacrifice.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 explicitly fears B appearing to care more, and A5 protects the heavier share.

records.recommendedEdit: Retained unchanged after rereading the original against the card. B4's helpful sharing offer causes A5's precise condition, so cooperation develops the behavior rather than ending it. The 92 reflects that unusually economical causal finish.
records.remainingConcern: A3's 'appear to care' risks sounding knowingly strategic; sincere concern about being out-cared remains playable. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: The actors must make a bag with a meaningfully heavier book side easy to imagine.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative b uses physical generosity and cooperative bargaining; a converts B's sentimental keepsakes into evidence for A.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We still make each other laugh awkwardly. That's a good sign.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That joke was painful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: But recognisably ours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Maybe we should stop talking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Look, we're negotiating. Another sign we're still engaged.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our first dinner since the breakup, and you still groan at my waiter joke.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I hoped you'd retired it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remembered. We've still got our little traditions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we eat in silence? I don't want another awful joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still know how to ask me for what you need. I'll order dessert so we have time.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 treats a painful joke as shared identity; A5 treats withdrawal as continued engagement.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's painful joke, although A5 labels B4's unilateral suggestion a negotiation.

relationship.evidence: B2 dislikes the joke and B4 wants silence, but the relationship and occasion remain unspecified.

heightening.evidence: A5 transforms an attempt to stop talking into stronger evidence of connection.

specificity.evidence: A1 describes awkward laughter without establishing where these people are or why they met.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'recognisably ours' is economical; A5's engagement claim follows B4's withdrawal.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 reads dislike of an old joke as shared tradition; A5 reads a request for silence as continuing emotional communication.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's remembered joke supports A3's tradition claim; B4's stated need supplies A5's 'ask me for what you need.'

relationship.evidence: B2 wants the joke retired and B4 wants quiet, creating credible friction with A's wish to prolong connection.

heightening.evidence: After B4 asks for less interaction, A5 interprets that as intimacy and commits to extending dinner with dessert.

specificity.evidence: A1 naturally identifies a first post-breakup dinner, an old waiter joke, and B's familiar groan.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'little traditions' and A5's dessert order follow the same hopeful misreading without a detached final joke.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 demonstrates remembering the joke while rejecting it; A3 selects the remembering as proof of connection.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 explicitly requests silence, and A5 converts that request into evidence of trust before extending dinner.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: The card explains why two expressions of irritation strengthen A's confidence in the relationship.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 turns stronger rejection into stronger confidence and a concrete investment in more time together.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A interprets awkwardness and disappointment as positive evidence that the relationship is still alive.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: General optimism finds an upside; this card specifically makes the setback evidence of continuing connection.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A3 calls the painful joke 'ours'; A5 calls stopping conversation proof they remain engaged.

records.recommendedEdit: The original lacks a sufficiently concrete occasion. The revision introduces a post-breakup dinner. Internal reread: fidelity 5 (A3 and A5 infer intimacy), logic 5 (B2's recognition and B4's request each supply evidence), relationship 4 (B wants a tolerable dinner), heightening 4 (A5 extends the meal), specificity 5 (A1 establishes the reunion), brevityWit 4 (dessert follows the hopeful misreading): 92. B4's request for silence becomes A5's reason to prolong their time.
records.remainingConcern: A5's language about needs is somewhat polished, but its dessert tactic is concrete and coherent. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5 should sound pleased to accommodate B, rather than pleased to defeat an objection.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative a prolongs an encounter despite irritation; b accommodates reduced access while treating that accommodation as mutual care.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've postponed dinner again. At least there's still a dinner to postpone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the third time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three chances to choose us eventually.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know when I'm free.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll keep the invitation. It's doing remarkably well.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've postponed dinner again. You still hate disappointing me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the third time. I feel awful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After three cancellations, my feelings still matter to you. That means something.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please stop holding Fridays for me. I can't promise anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're protecting my Fridays now. I'll leave the date open; we're already looking after each other.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 converts postponement into hope, but A3's 'eventually' predicts connection more than proving it remains alive.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's three postponements; A5 keeps the invitation after B4 cannot name a date.

relationship.evidence: B2 acknowledges repeated cancellation and B4 cannot offer availability, limiting A's options.

heightening.evidence: A5 preserves the invitation but shifts attention from their connection to the invitation's health.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a repeatedly postponed dinner, sharpened by B2's third cancellation.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'doing remarkably well' personifies the invitation instead of sharpening the relational inference.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 treats repeated cancellations and guilt as proof of significance; A5 treats unavailable Fridays as protective care.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's third cancellation and remorse; A5 directly reframes B4's request to stop reserving Fridays.

relationship.evidence: B2 expresses guilt and B4 withdraws any scheduling promise, giving B a credible concern about creating expectations.

heightening.evidence: A5 sustains belief in mutual care even after B4 removes a future date, expanding hope beyond an actual booking.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes postponed dinner, B2 counts three cancellations, and B4 identifies the Fridays A has been holding.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'protecting my Fridays' neatly transforms B4's disappointing request, though A3 spells out its emotional inference.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 supplies both the cancellation count and guilt; A3 makes that continuing guilt evidence that A matters.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 asks A to release Fridays without promising another date; A5 accepts that arrangement as care for A's time.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A consistently interprets disappointing availability as proof that the connection survives.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 finds mutual caretaking in the removal of any definite meeting, rather than requiring reassurance or a replacement date.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A treats disappointing attempts to arrange contact as present evidence of mutual attachment.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Patient hope waits for a future relationship; this behavior claims the disappointing exchange already proves one exists.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A1 finds significance in having dinner to postpone, while A5 weakens that focus by praising the invitation.

records.recommendedEdit: Revised to replace abstract future hope with evidence A extracts from B's concern. The postponed-dinner setting remains. Internal reread: fidelity 5 (A3 and A5 claim current mutual care), logic 5 (B2's guilt and B4's release of Fridays drive each inference), relationship 4 (B wants to stop inconveniencing A), heightening 4 (A5 names reciprocal care), specificity 4 (Fridays make the cost concrete), brevityWit 4 (A5's protection claim follows the request): 90.
records.remainingConcern: A5's 'leave the date open' could mean flexible scheduling or continued waiting; the positive reinterpretation is nevertheless clear. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: The ending is quietly hopeful rather than sharply comic; its success depends on A believing the inference.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative b uses accommodating optimism under uncertain availability; a uses optimistic persistence to extend a tense dinner.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put an extra blanket on your bed. I wouldn't want you overlooked.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's rather tight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carefully tucked. Unlike certain promises.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you loosen it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'm experienced at adjusting my expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've warmed your side of the bed, love. You sounded frozen waiting for that taxi.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could have picked me up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could. Here's another blanket. I remember waiting outside your office last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised. Could you warm my feet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come here, love. Both feet. I wouldn't leave any part of you waiting forty minutes.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 provides a blanket and A5 agrees to loosen it, but A3's promises remain an unspecified grievance.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's tight blanket prompts A3's tucked claim; B4's loosening request prompts A5's adjustment metaphor.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 seek physical comfort without engaging the hinted history of broken promises.

heightening.evidence: A5 repeats the general grievance through expectations without revealing or increasing its stakes.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes bedding, but A3's 'certain promises' gives actors no concrete shared wound.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's adjusting expectations follows B4's request neatly, though it is a familiar abstraction.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 gives another blanket while recalling abandonment; A5 warmly welcomes both feet while specifying the old forty-minute wait.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's pickup complaint prompts A3's reciprocal waiting grievance; B4's feet request becomes A5's affectionate comparison.

relationship.evidence: B2 challenges A's earlier absence, then B4 invokes an apology and seeks comfort, making affection and grievance coexist.

heightening.evidence: A5 increases physical care and sharpens the remembered injury from waiting at Christmas to exactly forty minutes.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a cold partner returning to a warmed bed; A3 identifies the office and Christmas as shared history.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'any part of you waiting' binds the feet request to the grievance, though the phrasing is conspicuously neat.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 says A could have collected B; A3 acknowledges that possibility while recalling when B left A waiting.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 requests warm feet after mentioning an apology; A5 grants the request but embeds the precise duration of the old injury.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A keeps providing intimate care, with resentment sharpening inside each new gesture rather than replacing affection.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 offers closer physical comfort and a more exact grievance in the same sentence.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A expresses genuine domestic affection while sharpening a remembered slight through each act of care.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Punitive withholding would deny comfort; A instead supplies comfort and lets resentment travel inside it.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A5 agrees to loosen the blanket even while invoking disappointed expectations.

records.recommendedEdit: Revised because the original's resentment was generic and B never addressed it. The new illustrative setting is a partner returning cold to bed. Internal reread: fidelity 5 (A3 and A5 pair care with the old wait), logic 5 (B2 raises pickup; B4 requests foot warming), relationship 4 (B challenges A and seeks affection), heightening 4 (A5 adds forty minutes), specificity 5 (A1's taxi and A3's office establish history), brevityWit 4 (A5 transfers waiting to B's feet): 92.
records.remainingConcern: The final comparison is polished, but the affectionate action and unresolved hurt remain playable. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: B2 can suggest deliberate non-collection; A's offered warmth must remain genuine rather than a disguise for punishment.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative b makes care physically intimate and responds to active requests; a keeps the encounter at the level of tea and verbal insinuation.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll let the argument go if you come to my opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought forgiveness was a gift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It is. Attendance is the wrapping.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm working?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we should settle the terms before I release the argument.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll let the argument go if you come to my opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought forgiveness was a gift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It is. I'd like to hand it over beside my paintings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm working that night. I could help hang them on Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hanging buys forgiveness. Stay to take them down and I'll stop mentioning the argument to Mum.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 prices forgiveness in opening attendance; A5 explicitly withholds release until terms are settled.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2's gift metaphor, but A5 does not price or otherwise use B4's specific work conflict.

relationship.evidence: B2 questions conditional forgiveness and B4 supplies a credible scheduling obstacle.

heightening.evidence: A5 restates the need for terms rather than changing the price when B4 cannot attend.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies an opening and required attendance, though the argument itself is unnamed.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's attendance-as-wrapping answers B2 economically; A5 is more procedural than pointed.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 prices forgiveness in attendance; A5 prices forgiveness and family discretion separately in practical favors.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 exploits B2's 'gift' framing; A5 accepts B4's hanging offer, though 'stay to take them down' leaves timing unclear.

relationship.evidence: B2 disputes transactional forgiveness, then B4 offers feasible support around work, making B an active negotiator.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4's counteroffer into a tiered bargain, adding silence toward Mum as a second purchasable benefit.

specificity.evidence: A1's opening, A3's paintings and B4's Sunday hanging establish the task, but A5's removal schedule is ambiguous.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's gift handover beside paintings and A5's 'Hanging buys forgiveness' express the bargain without extraneous jokes.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 calls forgiveness a gift; A3 preserves that label while locating delivery at the desired opening.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 replaces attendance with hanging help; A5 accepts that payment and offers an additional benefit for removal help.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: The card explains A's conversion of forgiveness and family loyalty into distinct exchangeable rewards.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 moves from one condition to a menu of favors buying different degrees of reconciliation.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A assigns explicit relational benefits to favors and sacrifices as negotiable prices.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Asking for support would not make forgiveness and future discretion conditional on separate payments.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A1 exchanges forgiveness for attendance, while A5 withholds the argument's release pending terms.

records.recommendedEdit: Revised to make the work conflict change the actual bargain. The opening is specified as an art show, with Mum introduced as shared family pressure. Internal reread: fidelity 5 (A5 prices two benefits), logic 5 (B2 shapes A3's gift; B4 supplies labor for A5), relationship 4 (B offers feasible help), heightening 4 (A5 adds a second charge), specificity 5 (paintings and installation labor are playable), brevityWit 4 (A5's itemization earns the turn): 92.
records.remainingConcern: The timing of 'stay to take them down' is awkward for an exhibition. The transactional causality remains clear; no whole-scene rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: The added family disclosure raises the pressure; it should remain a sincere negotiation rather than a triumphant threat.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative a negotiates practical exhibition labor and family discretion; b controls domestic access through a graduated schedule of contact.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, let's reconnect. I'll come for dinner and leave at ten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can start with why I'm leaving at ten tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's not the same thing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's the version of closeness I can promise.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, let's reconnect. I'll come for dinner and leave at ten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Put that before pudding so we finish on something nice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm still upset at ten?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll book another dinner. I want us to keep seeing each other without either evening running over.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 agrees to reconnect with a departure boundary; A3 substitutes that boundary for discussing the earlier departure.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's 'why you left'; A5 answers B4's distinction only through a general statement.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to address the rupture and B4 refuses to equate it with tonight's logistics.

heightening.evidence: A5 explains the existing limit without adding a tactic, condition or consequence after B4's correction.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes dinner and ten o'clock; B2 supplies the unresolved departure.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 has a clear verbal pivot, but A5 becomes an explanatory statement of the premise.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 agrees to reconnect with a ten-o'clock limit; A3 schedules hurt before pudding; A5 preserves that limit despite unresolved upset.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's demand to discuss the departure becomes A3's agenda item; B4's lingering upset prompts A5's bounded repeat dinner.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants an explanation and B4 challenges whether A's timetable permits emotional repair.

heightening.evidence: A5 extends A's preferred boundary from a single dinner into the ongoing structure of reconciliation.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes reconnection over dinner with a precise departure time; A3's pudding makes the agenda physically playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's placement of the painful subject before pudding and A5's fear of evenings 'running over' earn their humor from A's priorities.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 requires discussion of why A left; A3 accommodates it only within A's preferred dinner sequence.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 asks what happens if hurt outlasts the cutoff; A5 offers another meeting while retaining the cutoff.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A pursues repair sincerely but makes emotional access conform to A's preferred duration and pleasant finish.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 turns the boundary into a repeatable arrangement governing the future relationship; it does not mandate a scene ending.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A agrees to relationship repair while reshaping its timing and emotional demands around personally convenient limits.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Simply refusing reconciliation would not include A's repeated offers of continued contact.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A1 says 'let's reconnect'; A3 moves the requested discussion onto A's preferred departure terms.

records.recommendedEdit: Revised because original A5 merely explains the boundary. Dinner remains the setting. Internal reread: fidelity 5 (A3 schedules hurt and A5 limits it), logic 5 (B2 determines the agenda; B4 causes another dinner), relationship 4 (B wants adequate emotional time), heightening 4 (A5 makes the cap govern future meetings), specificity 4 (pudding and ten anchor the terms), brevityWit 4 (A5's caring invitation carries the restriction): 90.
records.remainingConcern: The self-benefit is understated enough to require A's sincere investment in the timetable. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A's convenient scheduling could read as reasonable boundaries unless the desire to compress B's distress remains evident.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative a offers repeated contact under fixed time limits; b separates difficult communication from enjoyable contact and controls when to receive it.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You promised to call. This is the same loop again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This time my battery died.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The explanation changed. My waiting didn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll do better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose what changes before we reuse that sentence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You promised to call. I kept dinner warm until eleven again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This time my battery died.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last time it was the train. Different explanation, same ruined dinner. Tomorrow I'm eating at seven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll borrow a phone next time. Please keep a plate for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how I end up waiting again. Miss another call and you're buying and cooking your own dinners.

specificity.evidence: A1's promised call and B2's dead battery establish an immediate recognizable dispute.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's changed explanation and unchanged waiting are economical; A5's reused sentence follows B4.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 equates battery and train explanations as one repeated pattern, then A5 escalates from eating earlier to withdrawing dinner provision.

specificity.evidence: A1's dinner kept warm until eleven and A3's seven-o'clock alternative make the domestic cost concrete.

hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 moves from a personal eating-time boundary to withdrawing shopping and cooking support.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: You want me beside you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Let's call that helping with the lighting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read the first line of this letter before I do.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Shall I read it aloud?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if your face stays reasonably ordinary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sit beside you. We can take one line at a time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep hold of the page too. I'll follow your finger. No need to ask why I'm taking so long.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't close the door yet. Count five breaths with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've counted five.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Could we try five without me checking you're there?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll stand here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the part making the counting work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you leave me in the new flat, count five breaths with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was five. Shall I close the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. Five more while I look at the empty kitchen instead of you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wait here while you put the kettle on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay until it boils. Then I'll try pouring one cup without getting yours out.

cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.text: I knew. I still looked at that empty seat before every song.
